sloka: कृत्यमस्ति महाज्जाने कर्तव्यमिति शत्रुभिः ।राक्षसास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा लङ्कायाम् परिचक्रमुः ॥६-११-१९॥।।
transliteration: kṛtyamasti mahājjāne kartavyamiti śatrubhiḥ ।rākṣasāstadvacaḥ śrutvā laṅkāyām paricakramuḥ ॥6-11-19॥।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.
